title: buxus sempervirens f. argenteovariegata
intro: Buxus sempervirens f. argenteovariegata, commonly known as the Silver Variegated Boxwood, is a cultivar of the Boxwood plant, known for its attractive, silver-leafed foliage. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of the plant include sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Buxus sempervirens f. argenteovariegata have been found to include alkaloids like buxine and flavonoids like quercetin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
